exposure: working in a healthcare facility in an urban setting
attended training where they were taught about hepatitis B PEP
cohort: The study included 306 healthcare providers (HCPs) selected from 55 healthcare facilities in Wakiso, a peri-urban district in Uganda.
finding: Only 10.8% of healthcare providers were aware of any hepatitis B post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) options, with awareness being associated with the main department of work and working in an urban healthcare facility.
